indicators.question: How leveraged are households relative to the economy?
indicators.application_context: Credit risk, consumption vulnerability, interest-rate sensitivity.

indicators.indicator_name: Internet Penetration Rate (% of total population)
indicators.definition: Share of population with internet access.
indicators.question: What proportion of population is online?
indicators.application_context: Digital channel reach, e-commerce potential, online media planning.

indicators.indicator_name: State-wise Internet Penetration data  (Internet Subscribers per 100 Population)
indicators.definition: Internet subscriptions per 100 population by state/region.
indicators.question: Which states have higher/lower internet adoption?
indicators.application_context: Regional digital targeting, state-level rollouts, localized campaigns.

indicators.definition: Number of active mobile subscriptions per 100 people.
indicators.question: How saturated is mobile connectivity?
indicators.application_context: SMS/OTT campaign reach, multi-SIM dynamics, mobile reach modelling.

indicators.definition: Mobile broadband subscriptions per 100 population.
indicators.question: How many users have mobile data-capable subscriptions?
indicators.application_context: Mobile-data based services, streaming potential, app usage forecasts.

indicators.definition: Fixed-line broadband subscriptions per 100 population/households.
indicators.question: What is fixed internet availability at homes/offices?
indicators.application_context: Home entertainment, streaming, fixed broadband product demand.

indicators.indicator_name: E-commerce Penetration (% of internet users who purchased online in past year)
indicators.definition: Share of internet users who bought online in the past year.
indicators.question: How many online users convert to e-commerce purchasers?
indicators.application_context: E-commerce market sizing, digital funnel benchmarks, logistics needs.

indicators.indicator_name: Digital Payment Adoption (% of adults who used a digital payment in past year)
indicators.definition: Share of adults using digital payments in past year.
indicators.question: How widely are digital payments used by adults?
indicators.application_context: Cashless strategy, payment method integration, checkout optimization.

indicators.definition: Count and aggregate value of UPI transactions (India).
indicators.question: How large is real-time digital payment usage?
indicators.application_context: Real-time commerce opportunities, payment-led UX, merchant settlement flows.

indicators.indicator_name: Television Viewership (Average daily viewing minutes, TRP of top channels)
indicators.definition: Average daily TV viewing minutes and channel/program TRPs.
indicators.question: How much time do people spend on TV and which shows rate highly?
indicators.application_context: TV media planning, schedule buying, creative placement.

indicators.indicator_name: Alcohol Consumption (Litres of pure alcohol per capita per year)
indicators.definition: Average annual litres of pure alcohol consumed per adult.
indicators.question: How prevalent is alcohol consumption and at what intensity?
indicators.application_context: Category size for beverages, regulatory risk, health-focused messaging.

indicators.definition: Share of adult population using tobacco (smoking/chewing).
indicators.question: How widespread is tobacco consumption?
indicators.application_context: Health-risk marketing, cessation product demand, regulatory sensitivity.

indicators.definition: Share of population following primary dietary preference.
indicators.question: What are dominant dietary habits?
indicators.application_context: Product formulation, category positioning, regional menu design.

indicators.definition: Share of workforce engaged in freelance / gig work.
indicators.question: How many people earn via freelance/gig channels?
indicators.application_context: Platform market sizing, flexible benefits, micro-entrepreneur targeting.

indicators.definition: Average expected lifespan at birth (years).
indicators.question: How long do people typically live on average?
indicators.application_context: Long-term healthcare planning, retirement product sizing.

indicators.definition: Average number of children a woman would have over her lifetime.
indicators.question: How many children are women expected to have?
indicators.application_context: Long-term population forecasts, baby & childcare market sizing.

indicators.definition: Share of adults classified as obese.
indicators.question: How common is obesity in the adult population?
indicators.application_context: Health & wellness product demand, nutrition interventions.

indicators.definition: Share of adults diagnosed with diabetes.
indicators.question: How widespread is diabetes in the population?
indicators.application_context: Healthcare service demand, specialized nutrition & pharma targeting.

indicators.definition: Share using public vs private healthcare providers.
indicators.question: Where do people primarily seek medical care?
indicators.application_context: Health partnership strategies, insurance product positioning.

indicators.indicator_name: Environmental Concern (% who agree climate change is a serious threat)
indicators.definition: Share of population that perceives climate change as a serious threat.
indicators.question: How concerned are consumers about environmental issues?
indicators.application_context: Green product demand, CSR positioning, sustainable innovation.

indicators.definition: Composite index reflecting consumer optimism about economy/finances.
indicators.question: How optimistic are consumers about spending and the economy?
indicators.application_context: Demand forecasting, promotional timing, inventory management.

indicators.definition: Share of population reporting high stress or anxiety.
indicators.question: What is the mental-health burden in the population?
indicators.application_context: Wellness product demand, employer benefits, communication sensitivity.

indicators.definition: Cultural tendency toward gratification vs social restraint (e.g., Hofstede).
indicators.question: Is the culture oriented toward enjoyment and leisure or restraint?
indicators.application_context: Brand tone, promotional aggressiveness, product messaging.

indicators.definition: Cultural preference for individualism vs collectivism.
indicators.question: Do people prioritize individual goals or group identity?
indicators.application_context: Community vs personal messaging, product positioning, segmentation.

indicators.definition: Degree to which society favors traditional norms and resistance to change.
indicators.question: How conservative or progressive are social norms?
indicators.application_context: Creative risk appetite, product acceptability, campaign localization.

indicators.definition: Cultural orientation toward long-term planning and perseverance.
indicators.question: Are people future-oriented or short-term oriented?
indicators.application_context: Subscription products, investment messaging, loyalty programs.

indicators.definition: Cultural tendency toward expressing individuality and self-realization.
indicators.question: How much do people value personal expression?
indicators.application_context: Customisation, premium niche products, influencer strategies.

indicators.definition: Share of population who believe in religion through god or a higher spirit or none.
indicators.question: How influential is religion in daily life and decisions?
indicators.application_context: Cultural-sensitivity in product design, festive marketing, timing.

indicators.definition: Level of public trust in government, media, and institutions.
indicators.question: Do consumers trust official institutions and brands?
indicators.application_context: Policy-sensitivity, partnership risk, crisis-communication planning.

indicators.definition: Composite ranking of a country’s innovation performance.
indicators.question: How innovative and R&D-capable is the country?
indicators.application_context: New product launch feasibility, tech adoption readiness.

indicators.definition: Self-reported satisfaction with family life (survey-based).
indicators.question: How satisfied are people with family relationships?
indicators.application_context: Family-oriented product positioning, emotional messaging.

indicators.definition: Population-level subjective wellbeing/happiness score.
indicators.question: How broadly satisfied and happy are citizens?
indicators.application_context: Brand positioning, wellbeing product demand, social licence.

indicators.definition: Total Revenue: Total income generated from the sale of goods and services before expenses.
indicators.question: How large is the company’s topline and how fast is it scaling?
indicators.application_context: Benchmarking company size, comparing competitors, identifying leaders.

indicators.definition: Revenue Growth Rate (YoY): Percentage change in revenue compared to the previous year.
indicators.question: Is the business accelerating, stagnating, or declining?
indicators.application_context: Signals business momentum, market acceptance, and competitive positioning.

indicators.definition: Net Income / PAT: Profit after all expenses, interest, and taxes.
indicators.question: How profitable is the company after all obligations?
indicators.application_context: Used to assess long-term sustainability and profitability benchmarking.

indicators.definition: Gross Profit Margin: (Revenue – COGS) ÷ Revenue.
indicators.question: How efficiently does the company convert revenue into gross profit?
indicators.application_context: Indicates pricing power, cost efficiency, and production economics.

indicators.definition: Operating Profit Margin: Operating Income ÷ Revenue.
indicators.question: How strong is the company’s core operating profitability?
indicators.application_context: Evaluates operational efficiency excluding financing/taxes.

indicators.definition: Net Profit Margin: Net Income ÷ Revenue.
indicators.question: How much profit does the company keep from each revenue dollar?
indicators.application_context: Measures overall profitability; used for cross-industry comparisons.

indicators.definition: EBITDA / EBITDA Margin: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.
indicators.question: What is the company’s cash-like operating profitability?
indicators.application_context: Normalizes profitability across industries; useful for valuation.

indicators.definition: Return on Equity (ROE): Net Income ÷ Shareholder Equity.
indicators.question: How well does the company generate returns on shareholder capital?
indicators.application_context: Key measure of capital efficiency and investor attractiveness.

indicators.definition: Return on Assets (ROA): Net Income ÷ Total Assets.
indicators.question: How efficiently is the company using its assets to generate profit?
indicators.application_context: Useful in asset-heavy sectors; signals management effectiveness.

indicators.definition: Return on Capital Employed (ROCE): EBIT ÷ (Debt + Equity).
indicators.question: How effectively is the company generating returns on total capital used?
indicators.application_context: Captures capital productivity; important for capital-intensive industries.

indicators.definition: Debt-to-Equity Ratio: Total Debt ÷ Shareholder Equity.
indicators.question: How leveraged is the company and how risky is its balance sheet?
indicators.application_context: Used for solvency analysis and cost of capital assessment.

indicators.definition: Free Cash Flow (FCF): Cash generated after operating + capital expenditures.
indicators.question: Does the company generate enough cash to reinvest and return value?
indicators.application_context: Valuation anchor, signals ability to fund growth/dividends.

indicators.definition: Operating Cash Flow: Cash generated from core operations.
indicators.question: How much cash does the company produce from everyday business?
indicators.application_context: Indicates liquidity, quality of earnings, and sustainability.

indicators.definition: Current Ratio / Quick Ratio: Current assets ÷ current liabilities (Quick excludes inventory).
indicators.question: Can the company meet its short-term obligations?
indicators.application_context: Liquidity health check, working-capital risk evaluation.

indicators.definition: Market Capitalization: Total value of outstanding shares.
indicators.question: How valuable is the company according to the market?
indicators.application_context: Used for benchmarking peers, investment analysis, size classification.

indicators.definition: P/E Ratio: Market Price ÷ Earnings per Share.
indicators.question: How expensive or cheap is the stock relative to earnings?
indicators.application_context: Guides valuation, growth expectations, investor sentiment.

indicators.definition: Earnings per Share (EPS): Net Income ÷ Shares Outstanding.
indicators.question: How much profit does each share generate?
indicators.application_context: Used in valuation and comparing earnings power across firms.

indicators.definition: Dividend Yield: Annual dividends per share ÷ share price.
indicators.question: What cash return do investors receive from owning the stock?
indicators.application_context: Helps income-focused analysis and capital-allocation evaluation.

indicators.definition: P/S Ratio: Market cap ÷ total revenue.
indicators.question: How is the company valued relative to its revenue base?
indicators.application_context: Useful for early-stage or low-profit companies; indicates market sentiment.

indicators.definition: R&D Expenditure (% of revenue): Share of revenue spent on research and innovation.
indicators.question: How much is the company investing in future growth and innovation?
indicators.application_context: Signals innovation intensity; important for tech, pharma, auto.

indicators.definition: Dividend Payout Ratio: Dividends ÷ Net Income.
indicators.question: How much profit is distributed vs. retained?
indicators.application_context: Evaluates capital allocation discipline and investor-return strategy.

indicators.definition: Industry Size: Total value of all companies operating in the industry.
indicators.question: How big is the overall market opportunity?
indicators.application_context: Supports TAM sizing, opportunity selection, strategic planning.

indicators.definition: Company's Estimated Market Share (%): Company revenue ÷ total industry revenue.
indicators.question: How dominant is the company within its industry?
indicators.application_context: Competitive benchmarking and share-gain/share-loss analysis.

indicators.definition: Market Ranking: Company’s position vs. competitors.
indicators.question: Where does the company stand relative to peers?
indicators.application_context: Used for competitor mapping and brand positioning.

indicators.definition: Sales Growth vs. Industry Growth: Company sales growth relative to industry’s.
indicators.question: Is the company outperforming or lagging the market?
indicators.application_context: Indicates competitive momentum and share shift patterns.

indicators.definition: Volume Growth: Increase in units sold over time.
indicators.question: Is customer demand increasing independent of pricing?
indicators.application_context: Tracks demand elasticity, consumption patterns, portfolio health.

indicators.indicator_name: Marketing & Advertising Spend (absolute and as % of sales)
indicators.definition: Marketing & Advertising Spend: Total marketing investment, absolute or % of sales.
indicators.question: How much is the company investing in demand creation?
indicators.application_context: Critical for assessing brand-building intensity, SOV/SOM strategy.

indicators.indicator_name: Cost per Acquisition (CPA) / Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
indicators.definition: Cost per Acquisition / CAC: Cost to acquire a new customer.
indicators.question: How efficiently does the company convert marketing into customers?
indicators.application_context: Central for unit economics, digital marketing performance, ROI.

indicators.definition: Customer Lifetime Value (LTV): Total expected profit from a customer over their life.
indicators.question: How valuable is each acquired customer in the long run?
indicators.application_context: Used in LTV/CAC modeling, retention strategy, cohort economics.

indicators.indicator_name: Digital Marketing Metrics (e.g., Click-Through Rate, Conversion Rate, Engagement Rate by platform)
indicators.definition: Digital Marketing Metrics: CTR, conversion rate, engagement rate, etc.
indicators.question: How effective are the company’s digital channels and campaigns?
indicators.application_context: Performance optimization, media allocation, attribution analysis.

indicators.definition: Number of Products / SKUs: Total active items in the product portfolio.
indicators.question: How broad is the company’s offering?
indicators.application_context: Portfolio complexity assessment, supply-chain and assortment design.

indicators.definition: Product Line Depth & Breadth: Number of variants within and across categories.
indicators.question: How diversified is the product portfolio?
indicators.application_context: Used in assortment strategy, competitive mapping, BCG analysis.

indicators.indicator_name: Sales by Product Line (Portfolio Analysis - BCG Matrix, etc.)
indicators.definition: Sales by Product Line: Contribution of each business line to total sales.
indicators.question: Which product lines drive growth or drag performance?
indicators.application_context: Supports BCG matrix, portfolio pruning, investment prioritization.

indicators.indicator_name: New Product Vitality Index (% of sales from products launched in last X years)
indicators.definition: New Product Vitality Index: % of sales from products launched recently.
indicators.question: How dependent is growth on innovation and new launches?
indicators.application_context: Indicates innovation capability, category relevance, future pipeline.

indicators.indicator_name: Product Quality & Reliability Ratings (e.g., J.D. Power awards, review scores)
indicators.definition: Product Quality & Reliability Ratings: Third-party or consumer-based performance ratings.
indicators.question: How do consumers perceive the company’s product quality?
indicators.application_context: Used for positioning, pricing power assessment, brand trust.

indicators.indicator_name: R&D Spending (absolute and as % of revenue)
indicators.definition: R&D Spending (absolute): Total money spent on research and development.
indicators.question: How much is the company investing in innovation?
indicators.application_context: Evaluates innovation scale and competitive differentiation.

indicators.definition: Number of Patents Filed/Granted: Count of IP assets created.
indicators.question: How actively is the company building intellectual property?
indicators.application_context: Proxy for innovation strength, competitive moat, tech leadership.

indicators.indicator_name: Number of New Product Launches per year
indicators.definition: Number of New Product Launches: Annual launches across categories.
indicators.question: How frequently does the company introduce new products?
indicators.application_context: Indicates innovation pace and responsiveness to market trends.

indicators.definition: Total Customer Count: Total active customers served.
indicators.question: How large is the company’s customer base?
indicators.application_context: Used for sizing reach, modeling LTV, and forecasting growth.

indicators.definition: Customer Retention / Churn Rate: % of customers retained or lost.
indicators.question: How effectively does the company retain customers?
indicators.application_context: Central to subscription models, CRM strategy, cohort analysis.

indicators.definition: Average Order Value (AOV): Average revenue per order.
indicators.question: How much does the typical transaction contribute?
indicators.application_context: Helps optimize pricing, bundling, and revenue per customer.

indicators.definition: Purchase Frequency: Number of purchases per customer over a period.
indicators.question: How often do customers buy from the company?
indicators.application_context: Key driver of LTV; used in loyalty and retention strategy.

indicators.indicator_name: % of Sales by Channel (Direct, Indirect, Online, Retail, Wholesale)
indicators.definition: % of Sales by Channel: Distribution of sales across online/offline/direct/retail.
indicators.question: Which channels drive the most revenue?
indicators.application_context: Supports channel strategy, omni-channel planning, resource allocation.

indicators.definition: E-commerce Penetration: % of total sales through digital channels.
indicators.question: How digital is the company’s sales mix?
indicators.application_context: Helps evaluate digital maturity, online channel strategy.

indicators.definition: Geographic Coverage: Number of markets/regions served.
indicators.question: How geographically diversified is the company?
indicators.application_context: Used for expansion planning, competitive presence mapping.

indicators.definition: CEO Approval Ratings: Internal or external approval scores.
indicators.question: How trusted and effective is the leadership?
indicators.application_context: Proxy for leadership stability and cultural health.

indicators.definition: ESG Scores: External ratings of environmental, social, and governance performance.
indicators.question: How responsible and sustainable is the company?
indicators.application_context: Used in investor screens, risk assessment, brand reputation.

indicators.definition: Industry Concentration (HHI): Measures market dominance of top players.
indicators.question: How competitive or concentrated is the industry?
indicators.application_context: Helps assess competitive intensity and regulatory risk.

indicators.definition: Porter’s Five Forces Data: Structured assessment of competitive forces.
indicators.question: What structural forces shape industry profitability?
indicators.application_context: Core for strategy development, opportunity evaluation, barriers analysis.

indicators.definition: Total monetary value of all sales in the category.
indicators.question: What is the total economic value of this market?
indicators.application_context: Market sizing, attractiveness assessment.

indicators.definition: Total number of units sold in the category.
indicators.question: How many units does the market sell annually?
indicators.application_context: Demand estimation, volume forecasting.

indicators.definition: Average price paid per unit in the category.
indicators.question: What is the typical price per unit?
indicators.application_context: Revenue modeling, pricing comparisons.

indicators.definition: YoY % change in market value (revenue).
indicators.question: How fast is market value growing?
indicators.application_context: Indicates category momentum.

indicators.definition: YoY % change in market volume (units).
indicators.question: Is demand expanding in units sold?
indicators.application_context: Gauges true category demand health.

indicators.definition: Average gross margin across category players.
indicators.question: What is the typical margin after COGS?
indicators.application_context: Pricing, profitability benchmarking.

indicators.definition: Average operating margin for the category.
indicators.question: How profitable is the category after OpEx?
indicators.application_context: Sustainability and business model viability.

indicators.definition: CapEx as a proportion of category revenue.
indicators.question: How capital intensive is this market?
indicators.application_context: Entry barriers, investment needs.

indicators.definition: Average P/E ratio for the sector.
indicators.question: How is the sector valued relative to earnings?
indicators.application_context: Investor sentiment, valuation benchmarking.

indicators.definition: Correlation between category growth and GDP growth.
indicators.question: How tied is this category to macro cycles?
indicators.application_context: Classifying discretionary vs. staples.

indicators.definition: Growth of core target demographic segments.
indicators.question: Are demographic factors expanding demand?
indicators.application_context: Long-term demand forecasting.

indicators.definition: Incentives, subsidies, or penalties applied to the category.
indicators.question: How do regulations financially influence this category?
indicators.application_context: Compliance strategy, risk planning.

indicators.definition: Speed of adoption of key technologies in the category.
indicators.question: How quickly is tech reshaping the category?
indicators.application_context: Innovation planning, competitiveness.

indicators.indicator_name: Market S-Curve Adoption Stage (Introduction, Growth, Maturity, Decline)
indicators.definition: Life-cycle position on the market S-curve.
indicators.question: Is the category in intro, growth, maturity, or decline?
indicators.application_context: Investment timing, portfolio strategy.

indicators.definition: Share of buyers who are first-time purchasers.
indicators.question: What % of buyers are new to the category?
indicators.application_context: Penetration opportunity sizing.

indicators.definition: Average product replacement or upgrade cycle.
indicators.question: How frequently do customers repurchase?
indicators.application_context: Demand forecasting, product planning.

indicators.definition: Index measuring market concentration.
indicators.question: How concentrated or fragmented is the market?
indicators.application_context: Competitive intensity, M&A screening.

indicators.indicator_name: CR4 / CR8 (Market Share of Top 4/8 Players)
indicators.definition: Market share of top 4 or top 8 players.
indicators.question: How dominant are leading players?
indicators.application_context: Entry feasibility, rivalry assessment.

indicators.definition: Count of meaningful active competitors.
indicators.question: How crowded is the market?
indicators.application_context: Landscape mapping, strategic positioning.

indicators.definition: Market share split between incumbents and disruptors.
indicators.question: Are disruptors gaining on legacy players?
indicators.application_context: Innovation pressure, risk to incumbents.

indicators.definition: Share of private vs. public companies.
indicators.question: What is the ownership mix?
indicators.application_context: Transparency, competitive behavior assessment.

indicators.indicator_name: Global vs. Regional vs. Local Player Share
indicators.definition: Share held by global vs regional vs local players.
indicators.question: Who dominates—global or local players?
indicators.application_context: Localization/GTM strategy.

indicators.definition: How often price-based competition occurs.
indicators.question: How frequent/intense are price wars?
indicators.application_context: Margin stability, pricing strategy.

indicators.definition: Number of new product launches annually.
indicators.question: How active is innovation in the category?
indicators.application_context: Signals innovation velocity.

indicators.indicator_name: Marketing & Sales Spend as % of Revenue (Category Avg.)
indicators.definition: Category’s average marketing & sales spend % of revenue.
indicators.question: How much is typically spent on marketing?
indicators.application_context: Budgeting, CAC expectations.

indicators.definition: Required R&D investment to compete.
indicators.question: How much innovation investment is needed?
indicators.application_context: Entry barriers, innovation planning.

indicators.definition: Degree of regulatory complexity.
indicators.question: How tough is compliance in this category?
indicators.application_context: Speed to market, operational risk.

indicators.definition: Stickiness based on loyalty or switching costs.
indicators.question: How loyal or locked-in are customers?
indicators.application_context: Retention, pricing power.

indicators.indicator_name: Age, Income, Gender, Geography of Primary Segments
indicators.definition: Demographic profile (age, income, gender, geography).
indicators.question: Who is the core target consumer?
indicators.application_context: Segmentation and targeting.

indicators.definition: Buyer lifestyles, values, motivations.
indicators.question: What intrinsic drivers shape demand?
indicators.application_context: Positioning, brand strategy.

indicators.definition: Typical purchase frequency and use occasions.
indicators.question: How often do consumers buy and why?
indicators.application_context: Forecasting, portfolio planning.

indicators.definition: Most effective awareness channels.
indicators.question: Where does the category build top-funnel awareness?
indicators.application_context: Media planning, upper-funnel strategy.

indicators.definition: Key factors influencing evaluation (features, brand, price).
indicators.question: What drives consideration?
indicators.application_context: Product design, feature prioritization.

indicators.indicator_name: Primary Purchase Channels (Online DTC, Marketplaces, Retail)
indicators.definition: Primary conversion channels (retail, online, DTC).
indicators.question: Where do consumers actually purchase?
indicators.application_context: Channel strategy, distribution planning.

indicators.definition: Sensitivity of demand to changes in price.
indicators.question: How does price change affect demand?
indicators.application_context: Pricing strategy, promo planning.

indicators.definition: Sensitivity of demand to prices of substitutes.
indicators.question: How does demand shift toward substitutes?
indicators.application_context: Competitive strategy, portfolio defense.

indicators.definition: Percentage of loyal, repeat category buyers.
indicators.question: How many customers repurchase regularly?
indicators.application_context: Retention planning, CLV calculations.

indicators.definition: Percentage of customers who stop buying the category.
indicators.question: What is the category’s churn rate?
indicators.application_context: Risk assessment, product improvement.

indicators.definition: Category-level Net Promoter Score.
indicators.question: How likely are consumers to recommend?
indicators.application_context: CX benchmarking, satisfaction health.

indicators.definition: % of products with essential baseline features.
indicators.question: What are table-stakes features?
indicators.application_context: Minimum viable offering definition.

indicators.definition: Prevalence of standout differentiating features.
indicators.question: What truly differentiates products?
indicators.application_context: Positioning, innovation focus.

indicators.definition: Key performance benchmarks (e.g., failure rate).
indicators.question: How reliable are products in this category?
indicators.application_context: Quality assurance, product claims.

indicators.indicator_name: Number of SKUs / Product Variants in the Category
indicators.definition: Total number of SKUs in the category.
indicators.question: How broad is category assortment?
indicators.application_context: Complexity management, assortment strategy.

indicators.indicator_name: R&D Spend as % of Revenue (Category Avg.)
indicators.definition: Category average R&D spend as % of revenue.
indicators.question: How R&D intensive is the category?
indicators.application_context: Innovation dependency assessment.
